// diagnostic

E0948

A pattern or range arm needs a plain `if subject == {` table

What

A pattern or range arm needs a plain `if subject == {` table

Why

A hole table puts each arm's candidate in its `<>` as a value, and a pattern or range is not a value; only a plain table matches each arm against its subject.

Fix

Write the table as `if subject == {`, or write this arm's candidate as a value.
